resolvedRule: 41 vocabulary terms whose text is head + parenthetical sense gloss ("geben (Unterricht)") and whose BARE HEAD is already its own inventory term. The gloss is a disambiguator, not spoken text, so the card shares the bare head asset. 41 terms × 2 voices = 82 assets left D and left the required-unique count as reusable.

notResolvable.slash-alternation: 222 terms ("der/die/das", "ein/eine"). Their alternates are NOT separate inventory terms, so there is no existing asset to share and no deterministic way to know whether the card should speak one alternate, all of them, or a merged phrase. Needs an authoring decision.
notResolvable.parenthetical-qualifier: 12 terms whose bare head is not itself an inventory term ("orientieren (sich)", "qm (Quadratmeter)") — reflexive markers and abbreviations where the spoken form is a judgement call.
notResolvable.pronunciation: 245 word-popup assets that are bare numerals, single letters, spelled-out strings ("B-U-C-H") or pronunciation hints ("TSAIT", "AP-fel"). None carry a lexicon pron/IPA field, so the intended reading cannot be derived from data.
notResolvable.speaker: 15 listening sentences in 4 B2 Goethe checkpoints with no authored speaker metadata. Gender was NOT inferred from the German text.

rows.text: In der Teamsitzung heute Morgen hat der Abteilungsleiter erklärt, dass das Projekt nicht rechtzeitig fertiggestellt werden konnte.
Es hängt hauptsächlich davon ab, dass zwei Kollegen krank waren.
Der Leiter ist keineswegs unzufrieden mit dem Team, aber er bittet alle, sich stärker auf die Deadline zu konzentrieren.
Am Ende der Sitzung nahmen alle Mitarbeiter an einer kurzen Diskussion teil.
In der Teamsitzung erklärte die Leiterin, dass das Projekt trotzdem erfolgreich war, obgleich es viele Hindernisse gab.
Sie verbesserten den Prozess, indem sie regelmäßig Feedback sammelten.
Nicht nur die Effizienz stieg, sondern auch die Zufriedenheit der Mitarbeiter.
Folglich plant das Team eine Erweiterung.
In der Firmensitzung erklärte die Managerin, dass sich die Arbeitszeiten wahrscheinlich ändern würden.
Seitdem das neue System eingeführt wurde, arbeiten viele Mitarbeiter flexibler.
Bevor die Entscheidung getroffen wurde, hatte das Team monatelang diskutiert.
Es klingt, als wäre die Umstellung erfolgreich gewesen.
Der Geschäftsführer, dessen Firma für Innovationen bekannt ist, ist verantwortlich für das neue Projekt.
Wer an diesem Projekt teilnimmt, der arbeitet direkt mit dem Team, dessen Erfahrung mit internationalen Kunden groß ist.

reconciliation.note: 730 rows carry a flag. 84 of them already resolve to existing audio through the repaired engine (the flag is a text-quality observation, not a blocker) and need no action. 730 − 84 = 646 rows genuinely require a human decision before they can be synthesized. The per-row `alreadyResolving` state is not stored here; re-derive it with audit/_audio-resolution-check.html if you want it per row.

classification.method: every row re-resolved live through kw-audio-engine.js with the real published manifests; classification is measured, never guessed
classification.reconciliation: 730 listed = 80 RESOLVE_EXISTING + 650 NEEDS_AUTHOR_DECISION. Of the 730, 715 carry an assetId present in the current inventory shards; 635 of those need a decision and are the D figure in the final arithmetic. SHARE_EXISTING_ASSET is 0 because the 41 shareable parenthetical terms (82 assets) were already reconciled out of D in the previous pass and are excluded from the C set.
classification.slashAlternationFinding: 80 of the 444 slash rows already resolve to published audio — a previous corpus rendered them, so those terms are served and need no decision. The remaining 364 have no published asset and no derivable spoken form.
whyAutomaticResolutionIsUnsafeForSlashTe: the term is a display convention, not an utterance: "der/die/das" is three articles shown together, "ein/eine" two, "eigene/eigener" two inflected adjective endings
the alternates are NOT separate inventory terms, so there is no existing asset to share
three readings are all defensible and the data does not choose between them: speak the first alternate only · speak every alternate in sequence as one file · speak the slash aloud
reading a slash aloud as a pause would teach a false form; picking the first alternate silently drops the contrast the card exists to teach
the correct reading is a teaching decision that lives with the author, not a derivation
